notes: Stolen courier body. Ivory robe and cowl, black hood opening framing an enlarged ivory mask tilted 36 deg up toward the game camera, slanted eye slits, dark boots/belt/satchel, vermilion shawl over the shoulders (rings the mask from above) with two broad tails falling back and out, flat faces turned to the camera so they read as cloth at ~40 px. Deviation: 3 materials (ivory, vermilion, mask_black) vs the 1-2 slot guideline; mask_black frames the face and breaks the silhouette. Parts: body pivot at hips (z 0.27), head pivot at neck (world z 0.50, child of body), mask child of head at the face centre, scarf pivot at the neck (child of body) for runtime sway.
